a.lede: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.
a.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy

b.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
